name: What is the process for getting a roof inspection and estimate?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting a roof inspection and estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with scheduling a free, no-obligation inspection of your roof. Our certified inspectors will assess your roof's condition, identify any damage, and discuss your options. Following the inspection, we will provide a detailed estimate outlining the scope of work, materials, and cost. We encourage you to ask any questions you have during this stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule a free inspection; we assess damage and provide a detailed estimate for the work.
